apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Fix: the app's native module (audio player, native voice, full vibration patterns) now actually loads. Before this, everything was falling back to the web player and basic taps.
Stronger swell on push and lower. Settings → Vibrations now shows whether full patterns or basic taps are running.
Rest start is now a crisp double-click followed by stillness, so it can't be mistaken for lowering.
